Current prerequisites: see live dependency edges (mote show). 2026-09-22 revision: film compiler and D1B end-to-end proofs moved to 1.1 (container bd-01M35MK5N6F0EWJE2EYT3D8Y9M); organization analyses moved to 1.1 (container bd-01M35P2EKWC52PZTMN2R5NMDFR). 1.0 = mapping of stories, videos, and their recall with flexible ingestion and fMRI-ready outputs.

Scheduling lane: release. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 4 Stability table, Release gate.

Ruling E was replaced on 2026-09-22 (P1a adopted, bd-01M2TA1P0GXBHRF24W0VE7B66D): 1.0 ships film-capable types plus video-as-timeline mapping; the film compiler is 1.1.

Scope:
The release decision.

Acceptance criteria:
1. docs/api-stability.md publishes the stability table decided in bd-01M35JGSMRABV1ANW341W76JWV; StoryModel and NarrativeCompiler are experimental in 1.0 (film compiler 1.1).
2. The support wire and decision contracts are frozen, with migration docs published.
3. Platform-labelled goldens are verified, and the Native 1-ULP governance bead is closed.
4. The forgeable align types (bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX) and the support-grain naming (bd-01M17AGFAVE90MA9QS50V0FTZD) are resolved before the freeze.
5. A green CI run is cited by URL, matrix cell and SHA.
6. MVP deliverables landed and green: 1.0 mapping journey bd-01M35P83TCNHBSDY6NSK13Q3K0 (Sherlock A and A+V, text story), video-only source package bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF, offline story ingestion bd-01M35PB1H5PDD55YVKR4TQ8M66, tabular StoryModel export bd-01M19XMQN4VK4WSTVSHBD3X1YB, real-text compile validation bd-01M35JHB8QV2A8T2WJY4EVR0A2, lambda weight bd-01M35MHPFFKQHSJKC07VMWC7CW, OpenNeuro export bd-01M354E83Z4Z7DR4KPP6Q45MAJ, public CLI bd-01M35B103S2KHRSF853GD2FYHW, and a current scored Sherlock development reproduction bd-01M35JFJCQ2ANTVED792H705X6.
7. The gate is independent of the superiority-claim gate.

Gate: fresh-context cold review of the committed text; the commit body states what changed and
what it does not establish.

Size: S.
